CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_autocorr_scan_frozen(p_as_of_event_time_ms bigint, p_horizons_seconds integer[] DEFAULT ARRAY[5, 15, 30, 60, 120], p_lookback_seconds integer DEFAULT 5, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 4, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(horizon_seconds integer, direction_mode text, n bigint, mean_gross_bps numeric, mean_net_bps numeric, win_rate numeric, autocorr numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric, fisher_p_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH params AS (SELECT greatest(1,p_lookback_seconds)*1000 lookback_ms,greatest(1000,least(p_sample_limit,100000)) sample_limit),
horizons AS (SELECT DISTINCT greatest(1,x)::integer horizon_seconds FROM unnest(p_horizons_seconds) u(x) WHERE x>0),
entries AS (
 SELECT s.id,s.session_id,s.event_time_ms,s.mid_price,s.spread_bps
 FROM public.feature_snapshots s,params p
 WHERE s.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND s.event_time_ms<=p_as_of_event_time_ms AND s.mid_price>0
 ORDER BY s.event_time_ms DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT (SELECT sample_limit FROM params)
),
observations AS (
 SELECT e.id,e.session_id,e.event_time_ms,e.mid_price,e.spread_bps,h.horizon_seconds,
        prior.mid_price prior_mid,prior.event_time_ms prior_time,
        future.mid_price future_mid,future.event_time_ms future_time
 FROM entries e CROSS JOIN horizons h
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT x.mid_price,x.event_time_ms FROM public.feature_snapshots x
   WHERE x.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND x.session_id=e.session_id AND x.event_time_ms<e.event_time_ms
     AND x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms-(SELECT lookback_ms FROM params)-3000 AND x.mid_price>0
   ORDER BY x.event_time_ms DESC,x.id DESC LIMIT 1
 ) prior ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT x.mid_price,x.event_time_ms FROM public.feature_snapshots x
   WHERE x.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND x.session_id=e.session_id
     AND x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+h.horizon_seconds*1000
     AND x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+h.horizon_seconds*1000+3000 AND x.mid_price>0
   ORDER BY x.event_time_ms,x.id LIMIT 1
 ) future ON true
),
valid AS (
 SELECT o.*,10000.0*(o.mid_price-o.prior_mid)/o.prior_mid lookback_ret_bps,10000.0*(o.future_mid-o.mid_price)/o.mid_price forward_ret_bps
 FROM observations o
 WHERE o.prior_mid IS NOT NULL AND o.future_mid IS NOT NULL
   AND o.prior_time>=o.event_time_ms-(SELECT lookback_ms FROM params)-3000
   AND o.future_time<=o.event_time_ms+o.horizon_seconds*1000+3000
),
scored AS (
 SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN v.horizon_seconds<60 THEN 'reversal' ELSE 'momentum' END::text direction_mode,
        CASE WHEN v.horizon_seconds<60 THEN -sign(v.lookback_ret_bps) ELSE sign(v.lookback_ret_bps) END direction
 FROM valid v WHERE v.lookback_ret_bps<>0
),
raw AS (
 SELECT s.*,s.direction*s.forward_ret_bps gross_bps,
        s.direction*s.forward_ret_bps-(2*p_fee_bps+coalesce(s.spread_bps,0)+2*p_slippage_bps) net_bps
 FROM scored s
),
stats AS (
 SELECT r.horizon_seconds,r.direction_mode,count(*) n,avg(r.gross_bps) mean_gross_bps,avg(r.net_bps) mean_net_bps,
        avg((r.net_bps>0)::int)::numeric win_rate,corr(r.lookback_ret_bps,r.forward_ret_bps) autocorr,
        avg(r.gross_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(r.gross_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_low,
        avg(r.gross_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(r.gross_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_high
 FROM raw r GROUP BY r.horizon_seconds,r.direction_mode
)
SELECT s.horizon_seconds,s.direction_mode,s.n,s.mean_gross_bps,s.mean_net_bps,s.win_rate,s.autocorr,s.ci95_low,s.ci95_high,
 CASE WHEN s.autocorr IS NULL OR abs(s.autocorr)>=0.999999 OR s.n<=3 THEN NULL
      ELSE erfc(abs(atanh(s.autocorr))*sqrt(greatest(1,s.n-3))/sqrt(2.0)) END fisher_p_value
FROM stats s ORDER BY s.horizon_seconds;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_combined_alpha_scan_frozen(p_as_of_event_time_ms bigint, p_horizon_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_purge_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_embargo_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 0, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(hypothesis text, fold integer, test_n bigint, signal_n bigint, signal_rate numeric, mean_gross_bps numeric, mean_spread_bps numeric, mean_net_bps numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH params AS (
  SELECT greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds)*1000 AS horizon_ms,
         greatest(0,p_purge_seconds)*1000 AS purge_ms,
         greatest(0,p_embargo_seconds)*1000 AS embargo_ms
),
entries AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.session_id, s.event_time_ms, s.mid_price, s.spread_bps,
         s.imbalance_1,
         c.open_time_ms AS candle_open_ms,
         10000.0*(c.close-c.open)/NULLIF(c.open,0) AS candle_return_bps
  FROM public.feature_snapshots s
  CROSS JOIN params p
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.open_time_ms,o.open,o.close
    FROM public.ohlcv_1m o
    WHERE o.symbol='BTCUSDT'
      AND o.interval='1m'
      AND o.open_time_ms + 60000 <= s.event_time_ms
    ORDER BY o.open_time_ms DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) c ON true
  WHERE s.symbol='BTCUSDT'
    AND s.event_time_ms <= p_as_of_event_time_ms-p.horizon_ms-3000
    AND s.mid_price > 0
    AND s.imbalance_1 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY s.event_time_ms DESC,s.id DESC
  LIMIT greatest(20000,least(p_sample_limit,200000))
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT e.*, f.mid_price AS future_mid,
         10000.0*(f.mid_price-e.mid_price)/e.mid_price AS ret_bps,
         ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY e.event_time_ms,e.id) AS fold
  FROM entries e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT x.mid_price
    FROM public.feature_snapshots x
    WHERE x.symbol='BTCUSDT'
      AND x.session_id=e.session_id
      AND x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms
      AND x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms+3000
      AND x.mid_price>0
    ORDER BY x.event_time_ms,x.id
    LIMIT 1
  ) f ON true
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT fold,min(event_time_ms) AS test_start,count(*) AS test_n
  FROM labeled WHERE fold BETWEEN 2 AND 5 GROUP BY fold
),
train_q AS (
  SELECT b.fold,b.test_n,
         percentile_cont(.20) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.imbalance_1)
           FILTER (WHERE l.event_time_ms < b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms) AS i20,
         percentile_cont(.80) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.imbalance_1)
           FILTER (WHERE l.event_time_ms < b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms) AS i80
  FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN params p
  JOIN labeled l ON l.event_time_ms < b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms
  GROUP BY b.fold,b.test_n,b.test_start,p.purge_ms,p.embargo_ms
),
scored AS (
  SELECT l.*,q.test_n,
    CASE
      WHEN l.imbalance_1>=q.i80 AND l.candle_return_bps>0 THEN 1
      WHEN l.imbalance_1<=q.i20 AND l.candle_return_bps<0 THEN -1
      ELSE 0
    END AS direction
  FROM labeled l JOIN train_q q ON q.fold=l.fold
),
signals AS (
  SELECT s.*,s.direction*s.ret_bps AS gross_bps,
         s.direction*s.ret_bps-(2*p_fee_bps+coalesce(s.spread_bps,0)+2*p_slippage_bps) AS net_bps
  FROM scored s WHERE s.direction<>0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 'l2_imbalance_plus_closed_1m_momentum_agreement'::text AS hypothesis,
         s.fold,max(s.test_n) AS test_n,count(*) AS signal_n,
         avg(s.gross_bps) AS mean_gross_bps,
         avg(s.spread_bps) AS mean_spread_bps,
         avg(s.net_bps) AS mean_net_bps,
         avg(s.net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(s.net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) AS ci95_low,
         avg(s.net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(s.net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) AS ci95_high
  FROM signals s GROUP BY s.fold
)
SELECT hypothesis,fold,test_n,signal_n,
       signal_n::numeric/NULLIF(test_n,0),mean_gross_bps,mean_spread_bps,
       mean_net_bps,ci95_low,ci95_high
FROM stats ORDER BY fold;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_conditional_alpha_scan(p_as_of_event_time_ms bigint, p_horizon_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_purge_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_embargo_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 4, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(hypothesis text, fold integer, test_n bigint, signal_n bigint, signal_rate numeric, net_ev_bps numeric, win_rate numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric, mean_spread_bps numeric, mean_gross_bps numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH params AS (SELECT greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds)*1000 horizon_ms,greatest(0,p_purge_seconds)*1000 purge_ms,greatest(0,p_embargo_seconds)*1000 embargo_ms),
entries AS (
 SELECT s.id,s.session_id,s.event_time_ms,s.mid_price,s.spread_bps,s.imbalance_1,s.microprice,s.order_flow_1s,
 CASE WHEN s.mid_price>0 AND s.microprice IS NOT NULL THEN 10000.0*(s.microprice-s.mid_price)/s.mid_price END microprice_dev_bps
 FROM public.feature_snapshots s,params p WHERE s.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND s.event_time_ms<=p_as_of_event_time_ms-p.horizon_ms-3000 AND s.mid_price>0 AND s.imbalance_1 IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY s.event_time_ms DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT greatest(20000,least(p_sample_limit,200000))
),
labeled AS (
 SELECT e.*,f.mid_price future_mid,10000.0*(f.mid_price-e.mid_price)/e.mid_price ret_bps,ntile(5) OVER(ORDER BY e.event_time_ms,e.id) fold
 FROM entries e CROSS JOIN params p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.mid_price FROM public.feature_snapshots x WHERE x.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND x.session_id=e.session_id AND x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms AND x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms+3000 AND x.mid_price>0 ORDER BY x.event_time_ms,x.id LIMIT 1) f ON true
),
bounds AS (SELECT l.fold,min(l.event_time_ms) test_start,count(*) test_n FROM labeled l WHERE l.fold BETWEEN 2 AND 5 GROUP BY l.fold),
train_quantiles AS (
 SELECT b.fold,
 percentile_cont(.20) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.imbalance_1) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms) i20,
 percentile_cont(.80) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.imbalance_1) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms) i80,
 percentile_cont(.25) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.microprice_dev_bps) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms AND l.microprice_dev_bps IS NOT NULL) m25,
 percentile_cont(.75) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.microprice_dev_bps) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms AND l.microprice_dev_bps IS NOT NULL) m75,
 percentile_cont(.25) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.order_flow_1s) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms AND l.order_flow_1s IS NOT NULL) o25,
 percentile_cont(.75) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.order_flow_1s) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms AND l.order_flow_1s IS NOT NULL) o75,
 percentile_cont(.75) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY l.spread_bps) FILTER(WHERE l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms-p.embargo_ms AND l.spread_bps IS NOT NULL) s75
 FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN params p CROSS JOIN labeled l GROUP BY b.fold,b.test_start,p.purge_ms,p.embargo_ms
),
scored AS (
 SELECT l.*,b.test_n,
 CASE WHEN l.imbalance_1>=q.i80 AND l.microprice_dev_bps>=q.m75 AND l.spread_bps<=q.s75 THEN 1 WHEN l.imbalance_1<=q.i20 AND l.microprice_dev_bps<=q.m25 AND l.spread_bps<=q.s75 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END d_imicro,
 CASE WHEN l.imbalance_1>=q.i80 AND l.order_flow_1s>=q.o75 AND l.spread_bps<=q.s75 THEN 1 WHEN l.imbalance_1<=q.i20 AND l.order_flow_1s<=q.o25 AND l.spread_bps<=q.s75 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END d_iflow
 FROM labeled l JOIN bounds b ON b.fold=l.fold JOIN train_quantiles q ON q.fold=l.fold
),
expanded AS (
 SELECT s.*,v.hypothesis,v.direction FROM scored s CROSS JOIN LATERAL(VALUES('imbalance_microprice_lowspread',s.d_imicro),('imbalance_orderflow_lowspread',s.d_iflow)) v(hypothesis,direction) WHERE v.direction<>0
),
sc AS (
 SELECT e.*,e.direction*e.ret_bps-(2*p_fee_bps+coalesce(e.spread_bps,0)+2*p_slippage_bps) net_bps FROM expanded e
),
stats AS (
 SELECT sc.hypothesis,sc.fold,max(sc.test_n) test_n,count(*) signal_n,avg(sc.net_bps) net_ev_bps,avg((sc.net_bps>0)::int) win_rate,avg(sc.direction*sc.ret_bps) mean_gross_bps,avg(sc.spread_bps) mean_spread_bps,
 avg(sc.net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(sc.net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_low,
 avg(sc.net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(sc.net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_high
 FROM sc GROUP BY sc.hypothesis,sc.fold
)
SELECT st.hypothesis,st.fold,st.test_n,st.signal_n,(st.signal_n::numeric/nullif(st.test_n,0)),st.net_ev_bps,st.win_rate,st.ci95_low,st.ci95_high,st.mean_spread_bps,st.mean_gross_bps FROM stats st ORDER BY st.hypothesis,st.fold;
$function$

  from public.feature_snapshots where symbol='BTCUSDT' order by event_time_ms desc limit greatest(1000,least(sample_limit,200000))
), candidates as (
  select b.*,v.feature_name,v.feature_value,f2.mid_price future_mid
  from base b
  cross join lateral (values ('imbalance_1',b.imbalance_1),('imbalance_n',b.imbalance_n),('order_flow_1s',b.order_flow_1s),('book_pressure',b.book_pressure),('spread_bps',b.spread_feature),('volatility_1s',b.volatility_1s)) v(feature_name,feature_value)
  cross join lateral (select x.mid_price from public.feature_snapshots x where x.session_id=b.session_id and x.event_time_ms>=b.event_time_ms+(horizon_seconds*1000) and x.event_time_ms<=b.event_time_ms+(horizon_seconds*1000)+3000 order by x.event_time_ms limit 1) f2
  where b.mid_price>0 and v.feature_value is not null

 from ranked group by feature_name,bucket)

  from public.feature_snapshots f, bounds b
  where f.symbol='BTCUSDT'
    and f.event_time_ms <= b.cutoff_ms - (horizon_seconds*1000) - 3000
  order by f.event_time_ms desc
  limit greatest(1000,least(sample_limit,200000))
), candidates as (
  select b.*,v.feature_name,v.feature_value,f2.mid_price future_mid
  from base b
  cross join lateral (values
    ('imbalance_1',b.imbalance_1),('imbalance_n',b.imbalance_n),
    ('order_flow_1s',b.order_flow_1s),('book_pressure',b.book_pressure),
    ('spread_bps',b.spread_bps),('volatility_1s',b.volatility_1s)
  ) v(feature_name,feature_value)
  cross join lateral (
    select x.mid_price
    from public.feature_snapshots x
    where x.symbol='BTCUSDT'
      and x.session_id=b.session_id
      and x.event_time_ms>=b.event_time_ms+(horizon_seconds*1000)
      and x.event_time_ms<=b.event_time_ms+(horizon_seconds*1000)+3000
    order by x.event_time_ms limit 1
  ) f2
  where b.mid_price>0 and v.feature_value is not null and f2.mid_price>0
), ranked as (
  select c.*,ntile(5) over(partition by feature_name order by feature_value, event_time_ms, id) bucket
  from candidates c
), stats as (
  select feature_name,bucket,count(*) n,
    avg(10000.0*(future_mid-mid_price)/mid_price) mean_forward_bps,
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by 10000.0*(future_mid-mid_price)/mid_price) median_forward_bps,
    stddev_samp(10000.0*(future_mid-mid_price)/mid_price) std_forward_bps,
    avg(spread_bps) mean_spread_bps,
    avg(10000.0*(future_mid-mid_price)/mid_price) gross_ev_bps,
    avg(10000.0*(future_mid-mid_price)/mid_price)-avg(coalesce(spread_bps,0))-coalesce(fee_bps,0) net_ev_proxy_bps,
    avg(case when future_mid>mid_price then 1.0 else 0.0 end) win_rate,
    min(feature_value) feature_low,max(feature_value) feature_high,
    min(event_time_ms) dataset_start_ms,max(event_time_ms) dataset_end_ms
  from ranked group by feature_name,bucket
)
select feature_name,bucket,n,mean_forward_bps::numeric,median_forward_bps::numeric,
       std_forward_bps::numeric,mean_spread_bps::numeric,gross_ev_bps::numeric,
       net_ev_proxy_bps::numeric,win_rate::numeric,feature_low::numeric,feature_high::numeric,
       dataset_start_ms,dataset_end_ms
from stats order by feature_name,bucket;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_funding_basis_scan_frozen(p_as_of_time_ms bigint, p_horizon_minutes integer, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 20000, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 0, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(agreement integer, n bigint, mean_gross_bps numeric, mean_net_bps numeric, win_rate numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
with params as (
  select least(greatest(p_sample_limit, 1000), 100000) as sample_limit
),
entries as (
  select s.id, s.symbol, s.server_time_ms, s.mark_price, s.basis_bps, s.last_funding_rate,
         lag(s.last_funding_rate) over (order by s.server_time_ms) as prev_funding_rate,
         lag(s.basis_bps) over (order by s.server_time_ms) as prev_basis_bps
  from public.funding_basis_snapshots s, params p
  where s.symbol = 'BTCUSDT' and s.server_time_ms <= p_as_of_time_ms
  order by s.server_time_ms desc
  limit (select sample_limit from params)
),
state as (
  select e.*,
         (e.last_funding_rate - e.prev_funding_rate) as funding_delta,
         (e.basis_bps - e.prev_basis_bps) as basis_delta
  from entries e
  where e.prev_funding_rate is not null and e.prev_basis_bps is not null
),
scored as (
  select st.*,
    case when st.funding_delta <> 0 and st.basis_delta <> 0
           and sign(st.funding_delta) = sign(st.basis_delta)
         then 1 else 0 end as agreement,
    sign(st.basis_delta) as direction
  from state st
  where st.basis_delta <> 0
),
fwd as (
  select sc.*, f.mark_price as future_price, f.server_time_ms as future_time
  from scored sc
  left join lateral (
    select x.mark_price, x.server_time_ms
    from public.funding_basis_snapshots x
    where x.symbol = sc.symbol
      and x.server_time_ms >= sc.server_time_ms + p_horizon_minutes * 60000
      and x.server_time_ms <= sc.server_time_ms + p_horizon_minutes * 60000 + 60000
    order by x.server_time_ms asc
    limit 1
  ) f on true
),
valid as (
  select fw.*, 10000.0 * (fw.future_price - fw.mark_price) / fw.mark_price as forward_ret_bps
  from fwd fw
  where fw.future_price is not null
),
raw as (
  select v.agreement,
         v.direction * v.forward_ret_bps as gross_bps,
         v.direction * v.forward_ret_bps - (2*p_fee_bps + 2*p_slippage_bps) as net_bps
  from valid v
)
select
  r.agreement,
  count(*) as n,
  avg(r.gross_bps) as mean_gross_bps,
  avg(r.net_bps) as mean_net_bps,
  avg((r.net_bps > 0)::int)::numeric as win_rate,
  avg(r.gross_bps) - 1.96 * (coalesce(stddev(r.gross_bps),0) / sqrt(count(*))) as ci95_low,
  avg(r.gross_bps) + 1.96 * (coalesce(stddev(r.gross_bps),0) / sqrt(count(*))) as ci95_high
from raw r
group by r.agreement
order by r.agreement;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_maker_wfo_scan(p_as_of_event_time_ms bigint, p_horizon_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_purge_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_maker_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 2, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(fold integer, fill_probability numeric, signal_n bigint, full_fill_net_ev_bps numeric, expected_attempt_ev_bps numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric, markout_1s_bps numeric, markout_horizon_bps numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
with params as (
  select
    greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds) * 1000 as horizon_ms,
    greatest(greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds), greatest(0,p_purge_seconds)) * 1000 as effective_purge_ms
),
entries as (
  select s.id,s.session_id,s.event_time_ms,s.mid_price,s.imbalance_1,s.spread_bps
  from public.feature_snapshots s,params p
  where s.symbol='BTCUSDT'
    and s.event_time_ms <= p_as_of_event_time_ms-p.horizon_ms-3000
    and s.mid_price>0 and s.imbalance_1 is not null
  order by s.event_time_ms desc,s.id desc
  limit greatest(20000,least(p_sample_limit,200000))
),
labeled as (
  select e.*,f.mid_price future_mid,
         10000.0*(f.mid_price-e.mid_price)/e.mid_price ret_bps,
         ntile(5) over(order by e.event_time_ms,e.id) time_bucket,
         m.mid_price mid_1s
  from entries e,params p
  join lateral (
    select x.mid_price from public.feature_snapshots x
    where x.symbol='BTCUSDT' and x.session_id=e.session_id
      and x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms
      and x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms+3000
      and x.mid_price>0
    order by x.event_time_ms,x.id limit 1
  ) f on true
  left join lateral (
    select x.mid_price from public.feature_snapshots x
    where x.symbol='BTCUSDT' and x.session_id=e.session_id
      and x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+1000
      and x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+3000
      and x.mid_price>0
    order by x.event_time_ms,x.id limit 1
  ) m on true
),
folds as (select generate_series(2,5)::integer fold),
boundaries as (
  select f.fold,min(l.event_time_ms) filter(where l.time_bucket=f.fold) test_start
  from folds f cross join labeled l group by f.fold
),
thresholds as (
  select b.fold,
         percentile_cont(0.2) within group(order by l.imbalance_1) filter(where l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.effective_purge_ms) q20,
         percentile_cont(0.8) within group(order by l.imbalance_1) filter(where l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.effective_purge_ms) q80
  from boundaries b cross join params p cross join labeled l
  group by b.fold,b.test_start,p.effective_purge_ms
),
signals as (
  select l.*,t.fold,
         case when l.imbalance_1>=t.q80 then 1 when l.imbalance_1<=t.q20 then -1 else 0 end direction
  from labeled l join thresholds t on l.time_bucket=t.fold
  where t.q20 is not null and t.q80 is not null
),
filled as (
  select s.*,g.fill_probability,
         (s.direction*s.ret_bps+coalesce(s.spread_bps,0)-2*p_maker_fee_bps-2*p_slippage_bps) full_net_bps,
         case when s.mid_1s is null then null else s.direction*10000.0*(s.mid_1s-s.mid_price)/s.mid_price end markout_1s,
         s.direction*s.ret_bps markout_horizon
  from signals s cross join lateral (values (0.25::numeric),(0.50::numeric),(0.75::numeric),(1.00::numeric)) g(fill_probability)
  where s.direction<>0
),
stats as (
  select fold,fill_probability,count(*) signal_n,
         avg(full_net_bps) full_fill_net_ev_bps,
         avg(fill_probability*full_net_bps) expected_attempt_ev_bps,
         avg(fill_probability*full_net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(fill_probability*full_net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_low,
         avg(fill_probability*full_net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(fill_probability*full_net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_high,
         avg(markout_1s) markout_1s_bps,
         avg(markout_horizon) markout_horizon_bps
  from filled group by fold,fill_probability
)
select * from stats order by fold,fill_probability;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_ohlcv_momentum_nonoverlap_frozen(p_as_of_open_time_ms bigint, p_lookback_minutes integer DEFAULT 240, p_horizon_minutes integer DEFAULT 240, p_oos_start_ms bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 4, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS TABLE(n bigint, mean_gross_bps numeric, mean_net_bps numeric, win_rate numeric, net_ci95_low numeric, net_ci95_high numeric, first_time_ms bigint, last_time_ms bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
with recursive params as (
  select greatest(1,p_lookback_minutes)::bigint*60000 as lookback_ms,
         greatest(1,p_horizon_minutes)::bigint*60000 as horizon_ms
),
base as (
  select o.open_time_ms, o.close
  from public.ohlcv_1m o, params p
  where o.symbol = 'BTCUSDT' and o.interval = '1m'
    and o.open_time_ms <= p_as_of_open_time_ms
    and o.open_time_ms >= coalesce(p_oos_start_ms, 0) + p.lookback_ms
  order by o.open_time_ms
),
kept(open_time_ms, close) as (
  select b.open_time_ms, b.close
  from (select * from base order by open_time_ms limit 1) b
  union all
  select nxt.open_time_ms, nxt.close
  from kept k cross join params p
  join lateral (
    select b2.open_time_ms, b2.close from base b2
    where b2.open_time_ms >= k.open_time_ms + p.horizon_ms
    order by b2.open_time_ms limit 1
  ) nxt on true
),
entries as (
  select k.open_time_ms, k.close, prior.close as prior_close
  from kept k, params p
  left join lateral (
    select x.close from public.ohlcv_1m x
    where x.symbol = 'BTCUSDT' and x.interval = '1m' and x.open_time_ms = k.open_time_ms - p.lookback_ms
  ) prior on true
),
scored as (
  select e.*, future.close as future_close
  from entries e, params p
  left join lateral (
    select x.close from public.ohlcv_1m x
    where x.symbol = 'BTCUSDT' and x.interval = '1m' and x.open_time_ms = e.open_time_ms + p.horizon_ms
  ) future on true
  where e.prior_close is not null and e.prior_close > 0
),
valid as (
  select s.*,
    10000.0*(s.close - s.prior_close)/s.prior_close as lookback_bps,
    10000.0*(s.future_close - s.close)/s.close as forward_bps
  from scored s
  where s.future_close is not null
),
raw as (
  select v.*,
    sign(v.lookback_bps)*v.forward_bps as gross_bps,
    sign(v.lookback_bps)*v.forward_bps - (2*p_fee_bps + 2*p_slippage_bps) as net_bps
  from valid v
  where v.lookback_bps <> 0
)
select
  count(*)::bigint as n,
  avg(gross_bps) as mean_gross_bps,
  avg(net_bps) as mean_net_bps,
  avg((net_bps>0)::int)::numeric as win_rate,
  avg(net_bps) - 1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) as net_ci95_low,
  avg(net_bps) + 1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) as net_ci95_high,
  min(open_time_ms) as first_time_ms,
  max(open_time_ms) as last_time_ms
from raw;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_sw1_scan_frozen(p_as_of_ms text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 4, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 1, p_funding_lookback integer DEFAULT 3)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, n bigint, signal_rate numeric, mean_gross_bps numeric, mean_net_bps numeric, win_rate numeric, net_ci95_low numeric, net_ci95_high numeric, first_entry_ms bigint, last_entry_ms bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_as_of_ms bigint := coalesce(public._parse_epoch_ms(p_as_of_ms), (SELECT max(open_time_ms) FROM public.ohlcv_1m WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT'));
  v_horizon_ms bigint := 86400000;
  v_fee_bps numeric := coalesce(p_fee_bps, 4);
  v_slippage_bps numeric := coalesce(p_slippage_bps, 1);
  v_lookback integer := coalesce(p_funding_lookback, 3);
BEGIN
  IF v_as_of_ms IS NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT 'overall'::text, 0::bigint, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (
    SELECT min(open_time_ms) AS series_start FROM public.ohlcv_1m WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT'
  ), grid AS (
    SELECT (SELECT series_start FROM bounds) + v_horizon_ms AS t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t + v_horizon_ms FROM grid WHERE t + v_horizon_ms <= v_as_of_ms - v_horizon_ms
  ), entries AS (
    SELECT
      g.t,
      entry_bar.close AS entry_close,
      prior_bar.close AS prior_close,
      exit_bar.close AS exit_close,
      fund.mean_funding
    FROM grid g
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.close FROM public.ohlcv_1m o WHERE o.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND o.open_time_ms>=g.t ORDER BY o.open_time_ms LIMIT 1) entry_bar ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.close FROM public.ohlcv_1m o WHERE o.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND o.open_time_ms>=g.t-v_horizon_ms AND o.open_time_ms<g.t ORDER BY o.open_time_ms DESC LIMIT 1) prior_bar ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o.close FROM public.ohlcv_1m o WHERE o.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND o.open_time_ms>=g.t+v_horizon_ms ORDER BY o.open_time_ms LIMIT 1) exit_bar ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT avg(sign(f.funding_rate)) AS mean_funding
      FROM (SELECT f.funding_rate FROM public.funding_rate_events f WHERE f.symbol='BTCUSDT' AND f.funding_time_ms<g.t ORDER BY f.funding_time_ms DESC LIMIT v_lookback) f
    ) fund ON true
  ), scored AS (
    SELECT e.*,
      sign((e.entry_close-e.prior_close)/nullif(e.prior_close,0)) AS ret_sign,
      sign(e.mean_funding) AS funding_sign
    FROM entries e
    WHERE e.prior_close IS NOT NULL AND e.entry_close IS NOT NULL AND e.exit_close IS NOT NULL AND e.mean_funding IS NOT NULL
  ), directed AS (
    SELECT s.*, s.ret_sign AS direction
    FROM scored s
    WHERE s.ret_sign = s.funding_sign AND s.ret_sign <> 0
  ), net AS (
    SELECT d.*,
      d.direction*10000.0*(d.exit_close-d.entry_close)/d.entry_close AS gross_bps,
      d.direction*10000.0*(d.exit_close-d.entry_close)/d.entry_close - 2*(v_fee_bps+v_slippage_bps) AS net_bps,
      ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY d.t) AS q
    FROM directed d
  ), total_candidates AS (SELECT count(*)::numeric AS total_n FROM scored),
  agg AS (
    SELECT 'overall'::text AS bucket, count(*)::bigint AS bucket_n,
      (count(*)::numeric / nullif((SELECT total_n FROM total_candidates),0)) AS signal_rate,
      avg(gross_bps) AS mean_gross_bps, avg(net_bps) AS mean_net_bps,
      avg((net_bps>0)::int)::numeric AS win_rate,
      avg(net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) AS net_ci95_low,
      avg(net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) AS net_ci95_high,
      min(t) AS first_entry_ms, max(t) AS last_entry_ms
    FROM net
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'quarter_'||q::text, count(*)::bigint,
      (count(*)::numeric / nullif((SELECT total_n FROM total_candidates),0)),
      avg(gross_bps), avg(net_bps), avg((net_bps>0)::int)::numeric,
      avg(net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)),
      avg(net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)),
      min(t), max(t)
    FROM net GROUP BY q
  )
  SELECT agg.bucket, agg.bucket_n, agg.signal_rate, agg.mean_gross_bps, agg.mean_net_bps, agg.win_rate, agg.net_ci95_low, agg.net_ci95_high, agg.first_entry_ms, agg.last_entry_ms
  FROM agg ORDER BY (agg.bucket <> 'overall'), agg.bucket;
END;
$function$

entries as (
  select s.id,s.session_id,s.event_time_ms,s.mid_price,s.spread_bps,
         s.imbalance_1,s.imbalance_n,s.order_flow_1s,s.book_pressure,
         case when s.mid_price>0 and s.microprice is not null then 10000.0*(s.microprice-s.mid_price)/s.mid_price end microprice_dev_bps
  from public.feature_snapshots s,params p
  where s.symbol='BTCUSDT'
    and s.event_time_ms<=p_as_of_event_time_ms-p.horizon_ms-3000
    and s.mid_price>0
  order by s.event_time_ms desc,s.id desc
  limit greatest(20000,least(p_sample_limit,200000))
),
expanded as (
  select e.*,v.feature_name,v.feature_value
  from entries e cross join lateral (values
    ('imbalance_1',e.imbalance_1),
    ('imbalance_n',e.imbalance_n),
    ('order_flow_1s',e.order_flow_1s),
    ('book_pressure',e.book_pressure),
    ('microprice_dev_bps',e.microprice_dev_bps)
  ) v(feature_name,feature_value)
  where v.feature_value is not null
),
labeled as (
  select e.*,f.mid_price future_mid,
         10000.0*(f.mid_price-e.mid_price)/e.mid_price ret_bps,
         ntile(5) over(partition by e.feature_name order by e.event_time_ms,e.id) time_bucket
  from expanded e join params p on true
  join lateral (
    select x.mid_price from public.feature_snapshots x
    where x.symbol='BTCUSDT' and x.session_id=e.session_id
      and x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms
      and x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms+3000
      and x.mid_price>0
    order by x.event_time_ms,x.id limit 1
  ) f on true
),
folds as (select generate_series(2,5)::integer fold),
boundaries as (
  select feature_name,fold,min(event_time_ms) test_start
  from labeled cross join folds where time_bucket=fold
  group by feature_name,fold
),
thresholds as (
  select b.feature_name,b.fold,
         percentile_cont(0.2) within group(order by l.feature_value) filter(where l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms) q20,
         percentile_cont(0.8) within group(order by l.feature_value) filter(where l.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms) q80
  from boundaries b cross join params p join labeled l on l.feature_name=b.feature_name
  group by b.feature_name,b.fold,b.test_start,p.purge_ms
),
oos as (
  select l.feature_name,l.time_bucket fold,
         case when l.feature_value>=t.q80 then 1 when l.feature_value<=t.q20 then -1 else 0 end direction,
         l.ret_bps-(0) as ret_bps,
         (2*p_fee_bps+coalesce(l.spread_bps,0)+2*p_slippage_bps) cost_bps
  from labeled l join thresholds t on t.feature_name=l.feature_name and t.fold=l.time_bucket
  where t.q20 is not null and t.q80 is not null
),
scored as (
  select feature_name,fold,direction*ret_bps-cost_bps net_bps
  from oos where direction<>0
),
stats as (
  select feature_name,fold,count(*) signal_n,
         avg(net_bps) net_ev_bps,
         avg((net_bps>0)::int) win_rate,
         avg(net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_low,
         avg(net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_high,
         abs(avg(net_bps))/nullif(sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)),0) z_abs
  from scored group by feature_name,fold
)
select feature_name,fold,signal_n,net_ev_bps,win_rate,ci95_low,ci95_high,
       case when z_abs is null then null else erfc(z_abs/sqrt(2.0)) end p_value
from stats order by feature_name,fold;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_wfo_signal_scan(p_as_of_event_time_ms bigint, p_horizon_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_purge_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_embargo_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 4, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(fold integer, test_n bigint, long_n bigint, long_net_ev_bps numeric, long_win_rate numeric, short_n bigint, short_net_ev_bps numeric, short_win_rate numeric, combined_n bigint, combined_net_ev_bps numeric, combined_win_rate numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
with params as (
  select
    greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds) * 1000 as horizon_ms,
    greatest(greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds), greatest(0,p_purge_seconds)) * 1000 as effective_purge_ms,
    greatest(0,p_embargo_seconds) * 1000 as embargo_ms
),
entries as (
  select s.id, s.session_id, s.event_time_ms, s.mid_price, s.imbalance_1, s.spread_bps
  from public.feature_snapshots s, params p
  where s.symbol='BTCUSDT'
    and s.event_time_ms <= p_as_of_event_time_ms - p.horizon_ms - 3000
    and s.mid_price > 0
    and s.imbalance_1 is not null
  order by s.event_time_ms desc, s.id desc
  limit greatest(20000,least(p_sample_limit,200000))
),
labeled as (
  select e.*, f.mid_price as future_mid,
         10000.0*(f.mid_price-e.mid_price)/e.mid_price as ret_bps,
         ntile(5) over(order by e.event_time_ms, e.id) as time_bucket
  from entries e
  join params p on true
  join lateral (
    select x.mid_price
    from public.feature_snapshots x
    where x.symbol='BTCUSDT'
      and x.session_id=e.session_id
      and x.event_time_ms >= e.event_time_ms + p.horizon_ms
      and x.event_time_ms <= e.event_time_ms + p.horizon_ms + 3000
      and x.mid_price > 0
    order by x.event_time_ms, x.id
    limit 1
  ) f on true
),
folds as (
  select generate_series(2,5)::integer as fold
),
boundaries as (
  select f.fold,
         min(l.event_time_ms) filter(where l.time_bucket=f.fold) as test_start,
         max(l.event_time_ms) filter(where l.time_bucket=f.fold) as test_end
  from folds f cross join labeled l
  group by f.fold
),
thresholds as (
  select b.fold,
         percentile_cont(0.2) within group(order by l.imbalance_1) filter(
           where l.event_time_ms < b.test_start - p.effective_purge_ms
         ) as q20,
         percentile_cont(0.8) within group(order by l.imbalance_1) filter(
           where l.event_time_ms < b.test_start - p.effective_purge_ms
         ) as q80
  from boundaries b
  cross join params p
  cross join labeled l
  group by b.fold,b.test_start,p.effective_purge_ms
),
test_rows as (
  select l.*, t.fold,
         case when l.imbalance_1 >= t.q80 then 1 when l.imbalance_1 <= t.q20 then -1 else 0 end as direction,
         (2*p_fee_bps + coalesce(l.spread_bps,0) + 2*p_slippage_bps) as cost_bps
  from labeled l
  join thresholds t on l.time_bucket=t.fold
  where t.q20 is not null and t.q80 is not null
),
oos as (
  select *, direction*ret_bps-cost_bps as net_bps
  from test_rows
  where direction<>0
),
stats as (
  select fold,
         count(*) as combined_n,
         count(*) filter(where direction=1) as long_n,
         avg(net_bps) filter(where direction=1) as long_net_ev_bps,
         avg((net_bps>0)::int) filter(where direction=1) as long_win_rate,
         count(*) filter(where direction=-1) as short_n,
         avg(net_bps) filter(where direction=-1) as short_net_ev_bps,
         avg((net_bps>0)::int) filter(where direction=-1) as short_win_rate,
         avg(net_bps) as combined_net_ev_bps,
         avg((net_bps>0)::int) as combined_win_rate,
         avg(net_bps) - 1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) as ci95_low,
         avg(net_bps) + 1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) as ci95_high
  from oos
  group by fold
)
select s.fold,
       (select count(*) from labeled l where l.time_bucket=s.fold) as test_n,
       s.long_n,s.long_net_ev_bps,s.long_win_rate,
       s.short_n,s.short_net_ev_bps,s.short_win_rate,
       s.combined_n,s.combined_net_ev_bps,s.combined_win_rate,s.ci95_low,s.ci95_high
from stats s
order by s.fold;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.research_wfo_threshold_scan(p_as_of_event_time_ms bigint, p_horizon_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_sample_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_purge_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, p_fee_bps numeric DEFAULT 4, p_slippage_bps numeric DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(feature_name text, threshold text, fold integer, signal_n bigint, net_ev_bps numeric, ci95_low numeric, ci95_high numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
with params as (
  select greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds)*1000 horizon_ms,
         greatest(greatest(1,p_horizon_seconds),greatest(0,p_purge_seconds))*1000 purge_ms
),
entries as (
  select s.id,s.session_id,s.event_time_ms,s.mid_price,s.spread_bps,
         s.imbalance_1,
         case when s.mid_price>0 and s.microprice is not null then 10000.0*(s.microprice-s.mid_price)/s.mid_price end microprice_dev_bps
  from public.feature_snapshots s,params p
  where s.symbol='BTCUSDT' and s.event_time_ms<=p_as_of_event_time_ms-p.horizon_ms-3000 and s.mid_price>0
  order by s.event_time_ms desc,s.id desc
  limit greatest(20000,least(p_sample_limit,200000))
),
expanded as (
  select e.*,v.feature_name,v.feature_value
  from entries e cross join lateral (values ('imbalance_1',e.imbalance_1),('microprice_dev_bps',e.microprice_dev_bps)) v(feature_name,feature_value)
  where v.feature_value is not null
),
labeled as (
  select e.*,f.mid_price future_mid,10000.0*(f.mid_price-e.mid_price)/e.mid_price ret_bps,ntile(5) over(partition by e.feature_name order by e.event_time_ms,e.id) time_bucket
  from expanded e join params p on true
  join lateral (select x.mid_price from public.feature_snapshots x where x.symbol='BTCUSDT' and x.session_id=e.session_id and x.event_time_ms>=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms and x.event_time_ms<=e.event_time_ms+p.horizon_ms+3000 and x.mid_price>0 order by x.event_time_ms,x.id limit 1) f on true
),
thresholds as (
  select l.feature_name,l.time_bucket fold,q.name threshold,
         percentile_cont(q.low) within group(order by l.feature_value) filter(where l2.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms) qlow,
         percentile_cont(q.high) within group(order by l.feature_value) filter(where l2.event_time_ms<b.test_start-p.purge_ms) qhigh
  from labeled l
  join (select feature_name,time_bucket,min(event_time_ms) test_start from labeled group by feature_name,time_bucket) b on b.feature_name=l.feature_name and b.time_bucket=l.time_bucket
  cross join params p
  cross join (values ('q05_q95',0.05::double precision,0.95::double precision),('q10_q90',0.10::double precision,0.90::double precision),('q15_q85',0.15::double precision,0.85::double precision),('q20_q80',0.20::double precision,0.80::double precision),('q25_q75',0.25::double precision,0.75::double precision)) q(name,low,high)
  cross join labeled l2
  where l2.feature_name=l.feature_name
  group by l.feature_name,l.time_bucket,q.name,q.low,q.high,b.test_start,p.purge_ms
),
oos as (
  select l.feature_name,t.threshold,l.time_bucket fold,
         case when l.feature_value>=t.qhigh then 1 when l.feature_value<=t.qlow then -1 else 0 end direction,
         l.ret_bps,(2*p_fee_bps+coalesce(l.spread_bps,0)+2*p_slippage_bps) cost_bps
  from labeled l join thresholds t on t.feature_name=l.feature_name and t.fold=l.time_bucket
),
scored as (
  select feature_name,threshold,fold,direction*ret_bps-cost_bps net_bps from oos where direction<>0
),
stats as (
  select feature_name,threshold,fold,count(*) signal_n,avg(net_bps) net_ev_bps,
         avg(net_bps)-1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_low,
         avg(net_bps)+1.96*sqrt(greatest(0,coalesce(variance(net_bps),0))/nullif(count(*),0)) ci95_high
  from scored group by feature_name,threshold,fold
)
select * from stats order by feature_name,threshold,fold;
$function$
